elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Which instruction identifies a control without relying solely on its location?
choices: Select Continue, the button at the bottom
Select the button on the right

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why is “press the square button” insufficient as the only instruction?

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Which related criterion addresses color as the only visual means of conveying information?

answer_key.q_1: Select Continue, the button at the bottom

explanations.q_1: The label Continue identifies the control independently of its location.
explanations.q_2: A person who cannot perceive shape needs another identifying cue.
explanations.q_3: 1.4.1 addresses use of color as the only visual means.
